author: Protel
body:
The Omega Update, as it is called, I believe really is 'Omega'. The update provided much needed updates throughout Avicus, even though there is contemplation as to "Why there is 1.8?", I believe you should look around the '1.8' part and focus on all the positives that were put into place. 

The overall fixture of the website, adding in new features, i.e. the search bar adding easy access to posts. Alongside the sublime format of when you happen to post/reply. In all, a fresh and clean new look to the site, hopefully making your experience well worth it, having easy access, and more available ways to prepare for the tournaments to come (create a team etc.).

The overall fixture of the server, for example, "Independent server rotations! Each server has a specified rotation of maps that it goes through every time it restarts. I believe we intend on making this public for the community to contribute, but it will stay private for now.Credits was a currency that existed on MC Zone, and it's back! It has replaced XP and can be used to buy various items from the hub shop in your inventory." This was all in the best interest of the community, alongside making the server more enjoyable. . .eventually, if not now. Also, guys look at what Kylo really implemented just for the communities benefit in-game, "/settings command. Used to enable, disabled and modify features on Avicus for your account./message and /reply commands that works. New hub: Fields of Green! Stable, lag-free lobbies (not tested with 100's of people). No more timeouts when the lobbies restart." 

Let the update do its work, as well as let the Developers fix the kinks out of it; I am positive this will be a massive improvement to the server, be appreciative (you asked for most of this, as server feedback/complaints), all in the best general interest of the community.

replies.body:
Ok, overall, it seems awesome. Alot better than before.

Prestiges:
I'm glad they removed it. When alot of people had prestige 1/2. They were just saying like "OMG, I'm better than you! You have no prestige! You suck!" ,etc. So thanks for removing it.

CTW:
This is problably the best thing in this update. It seems like people are enjoying it really much, so that's good.

1.8
As I've seen, people don't like 1.8 very much, but I can't see any problems with it. A tip is just to download optifine and you will be alot less laggier.

Once again, really good update!
